boundaries: Rules start at the selected canonical lookup return, with RBX=provided machine, ESI=requested 32-bit state ID and RDI=provided shared MethodInfo. Entry capture/carrier continuity is not proved by these fragments.
Normal Win64 calls and the provided machine/MethodInfo carriers are explicit premises. Callback and barrier reentrancy is permitted; each post-call read is independent.
Physical current+64 and state ID+32 are selected reads, not closed nominal field-layout proofs.
Slot requests do not prove the virtual helper selected a particular live callback or CenterSkillState instance.
Canonical Int32Enum/object implementation registration is exact; closed Center specialization runtime selection remains unresolved.

Virtual enum helper fallback proves receiver/32-bit ID/MethodInfo forwarding only if the selected code pointer differs from each of three inlined targets. Class preparation must return normally; actual heap class/vtable population remains an external runtime premise.

CenterSkillState.OnEnter nominal vtable slot and original method pointer are proved to be a non-inlined enum-helper fallback target. This does not prove the actual runtime receiver class or selected callback target; equality to that original pointer remains an explicit premise.

Tick canonical body has complete selected main/cold-path semantic grammar. Selector and transition-executor effects, float virtual helper dispatch, supplied MethodInfo, heap field reads, and callbacks remain explicit inputs; no closed Center Tick runtime selection is inferred.

Transition executor original canonical Transit(ref curState) reads physical from/to pointers. Post-callback and post-barrier rereads are independent; no final current value is promised after enter tail-call. Physical transition field nominal ownership and live selected transition identity remain unresolved.

Lookup proves ContainsKey call AL controls null versus a fresh dictionary load followed by get_Item with the original 32-bit key; dictionary helper effects and initialized provided RGCTX are premises, so concurrent mutation is not excluded. Condition fragment proves absent checker returns true and three pointer mismatches call the stored delegate pointer with stored target RCX and MethodInfo RDX. It does not bind any CenterSkillState _ToSkill closure to that actual pointer or prove inlined target semantics.

AddState proves two physical context reference stores with the selected barrier, whose complete closed-leaf grammar from the lifecycle contract preserves R10/R11 on the same native image. Context initialization may have effects; the state ID is read after first initialization. Dictionary Add is an opaque tail request. Closed Center generic runtime selection, nominal ownership of physical context slots and dictionary effects remain unresolved.

Selector constructs a physical enumerator with the provided list, zero index, observed list version and null current. The selected MoveNext first compares version then unsigned index versus size; successful yield reads the bounded array element, stores current, increments index and returns true. Slow path rechecks version after optional class preparation, sets index=size+1/current=null and returns false, or requests opaque failure on version mismatch. Reached calls must return normally; helper effects, shared-memory races, runtime RGCTX and actual list lifetime remain conditional. Enumerated order is not a proved transition priority.
